text.tspan: Where a Terraform run spends time, and how to cut it
Don't: -target as a habit (partial state) · -lock=false (state corruption) · huge -parallelism against AWS (throttling)
Measure first: time terraform init / plan · terraform state list | wc -l · TF_LOG=TRACE for slow or throttled calls.
Also: upgrade Terraform/providers, bigger runner in the same region as the state bucket and APIs.
